fact: Pi Taskbook delegates worktree creation and management for /taskbook-new to T3's t3_thread_launch MCP tool with workspaceStrategy.type=worktree, without allocating a checkout itself.
/taskbook-handoff uses T3's native worktree status, listing, and handoff tools to move the current thread or reuse a matching binding.
The Taskbook entry checks the bound T3 worktree path and branch before executing the handed-off task in its destination.
T3's continuation and setup script receipts describe separate operations. Taskbook reports each status independently.
Taskbook preserves the prepared branch and commit in the Pi session before asking T3 to move the thread, so re-entry can resume against the original target.
T3 Code 0.1.11 derives the provider-session HTTP /mcp URL from the server listener address. Taskbook accepts loopback and IP addresses assigned to a local interface.
